title: cassine tetragona
intro: Cassine tetragona, commonly known as Cassine or Texas Sage, is a perennial shrub native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and aiding in the management of diabetes. The therapeutic actions of Cassine tetragona include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
